step.cmd: In NWS, create a ROD for the refusal of employment issue as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “[Integrity case number] — [refusal of employment or failure to take advantage of a job opportunity] — [name of the employer] — good cause not shown.”
Details: Document the decision and rationale according to the National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if the claim for benefits is active, terminated, blocked or archived:

ul.li: If the claim is active, go to step 3.

If the claim is terminated, but may be reactivated:
On the Dormant tab, select the appropriate BPC.
Select Reactivate .
Go to step 3.
If the claim is blocked or archived, go to step 4.

step.cmd: Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to remove the MA and input the disqualification as follows:

ul.li: Manual Action: Select the appropriate MA (if required).
Rescind: Check the box.
Action: Select Add .

Disqualification: Select the appropriate option:
6 – Refusal of employment
7 – Neglect to avail – Just cause not proven –
Number of weeks: Select the number of weeks between 7 and 12 weeks.
Effective: Select the w/c for the failure to take advantage of a job opportunity.
Infraction: Select F - Non-fraud - Other .
Message: Select 1 - An overpayment resulted due to a disqualification
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .
Complete: C - Yes .
Select Update .
Go to step 14.

step.cmd: Determine the blocked claim’s status by reviewing the Blocked Status column on the Blocked tab:

ul.li: If 1 - Updateable is displayed , go to step 5.
If 2 - Not blocked is displayed, return to step 2.
If any other CS is displayed, go to step 12.

step.cmd: Review the Blocked Action Pending column:

ul.li: If Yes is displayed in one of the rows, go to step 6.
If all rows are blank, go to step 8.

step.cmd: In NWS, move the WI to Pending as follows:

ul.li: Pending reason: Select Other .
Comments: Type “Waiting for an updateable CS in BCS.”
Bring forward date: Enter the next working day.

step.cmd: When the WI moves to the current workload, in FTS, review the Blocked Action Pending column on the Blocked tab:

ul.li: If Yes is displayed in one of the rows, return to step 6.
If all rows are blank, go to step 8.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the BPC you want to update from the Blocked Status column. When the Blocked Claim screen opens, complete the following:

ul.li: Action required: Select Claim update .
Agreed deduction: Select (100%) Blocked claim system default .
Registration number: Select the applicable registration number.
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .

Complete: Select the appropriate option:
C - Yes to clear the registration number.
D - No to leave the registration number open for subsequent transactions.
Select Update .

step.cmd: On the Disqualifications tab, input the disqualification on the Disqualifications section as follows (up to 3 disqualifications in BCS can be imposed or rescinded):

ul.li: Action: Select A - Add .

Type: Select the appropriate option:
6 - Refusal of employment
7 - Neglect to avail – Just cause not proven
Number of weeks: Select the number of weeks between 7 and 12 weeks.
Effective: Select the w/c for the failure to take advantage of a job opportunity.
Infraction: Select F - Non-fraud - Other .
Message: Select 1 - An overpayment resulted due to a disqualification .
Select Update .

step.cmd: On the Pending Transactions tab, review the transaction:

ul.li: If the transaction shown is incorrect, go to step 11.
If the transaction shown is correct, click Close and go to step 14.

step.cmd: Delete the incorrect transaction as follows:

ul.li: Delete: Check the box next to the incorrect transaction.
Select Update .
Return to step 9.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operation Centre Memo (MM06) transaction as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the applicable registration number.
Memo (MPS): Check the box.
Detection: Select the investigation type as displayed in NISS.
Infraction: Select F - Non-fraud - Other .
Message: Select 1 - An overpayment resulted due to a disqualification .
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .
Complete: Select D - No to leave the registration number open for subsequent transactions.
Select Update .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: BPC: Select the BPC of the claim with the unreported voluntary leaving.
Work item: Select 91 - Overpayment .
Work type: Select 2 - Non-misrepresentation .
Earnings to be allocated: Leave the field blank.
Remarks line 1: Type “D6 or D7 from w/c [XXXX] to [XXXX].”
Remarks line 2: Type “ACS letter already sent.”
Remarks line 3: Leave the field blank.
Remarks line 4: Leave the field blank.
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .
Complete: Select C - Yes .
Select Update .

step.cmd: In ACS, create and send the D-91-00-00 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li: Date claimant called or information sent (1542)

Definite Disqualification Messages – D6/D7/D9 (2918)
D6 - Did not apply or accept a certain job - Post-audit (2919) or D7 - Neglected to take advantage / Failed to return (2921)
We/We have re-examined your claim/In addition, we (2916)
Number of weeks disqualified (1294)
Text: Name of employer(s) (1502)
Date of event (1292)
No reply from claimant / reply received with an explanation / reply received with no explanation (2938)
False representation message / Number of omissions or false representations (2941): Select Blank .
Levels of misrepresentation (12292): Select Blank .
Penalty message / Warning message (2950): Select Blank .

Overpayment messages (2452): Select the appropriate option:
Blank if there is no resulting overpayment
Overpayment – No misrepresentation and active claim
Overpayment – No misrepresentation and inactive claim

step.cmd: In NIIS, from Report of Investigation , select the Decision tab and complete the following fields:

ul.li: Disentitlement: Select Yes .

Reason: Select the appropriate option:
Refusal of employment (D06)
Neglect to avail. (D07)
Penalty: Select No .
Warning: Select No .
Violation: Select No .
Select OK .

step.cmd: In NWS, complete the CR Integrity WI.
